flags.message: The provisioned September oppositions report pre-snapshot cert denials in related Curtis v. Inslee (June 1, 2026) and Health Freedom Defense Fund v. Carvalho (May 18, 2026). Those related-case facts materially lower this forward forecast and weaken the May petition's consolidation proposal. They are not this petition's outcome; no target-case disposition was retrieved or known. The related dispositions were taken from the supplied briefs, not independently verified.
